overloads.semanticRole: The APPEND DATA TO PASTEBOARD command appends to the pasteboard the data contained in the BLOB data under the data type specified in dataType .

constraints: Under Windows, when dataType is a Text data type ("TEXT", com.4d.private.text.native, or com.4d.private.text.utf16), the string in the data BLOB must end with a NULL character.

To append multiple instances of the same data type, or non-text/non-picture data, use APPEND DATA TO PASTEBOARD; to clear the pasteboard and set a single text/picture/file-path value, use SET TEXT TO PASTEBOARD / SET PICTURE TO PASTEBOARD / SET FILE TO PASTEBOARD instead.
To append fresh data (rather than add to what's already there), call CLEAR PASTEBOARD first.
